rule_target: 説明可能な decision tree / affine hash / color-role rule
lowering_target: small Gather or pruned branch graph; no per-example label table
reject_lowering: arc-gen memorization, large ScatterND, large MatMul hash
best_practice: teacher artifactはoracleとしてprofileし、入出力差分から人間可読なinvariantだけを採用する。

rule_target: fixed crop / object-anchor crop / shape rule / bbox crop
lowering_target: constant Slice/Gather, small Pad/Concat, static row-column indices
reject_lowering: NonZero, Compress, full-grid GatherND bbox, full-grid Tile
best_practice: bboxを見つけてもすぐONNX化せず、index table sizeとactivation memoryを先に見積もる。

rule_target: changed-cell rule / component completion / object copy with sparse mask
lowering_target: tiny coordinate ScatterND, small Conv kernels, Equal plus one Where
reject_lowering: large coordinate initializer, repeated full-grid Where, unrolled local propagation
best_practice: 変更セル数が少ないことを証明してから、全grid処理を避けるloweringだけをemitする。

rule_target: seed-to-line / ray / periodic pattern with color roles
lowering_target: constant affine masks, row-column masks, small Conv line detectors
reject_lowering: per-cell ScatterND table, long Where chains over all periods
best_practice: seed、方向、period、stop conditionを分けて探索し、絶対色ではなくroleで記述する。

rule_target: row-column completion / line extension / grid crossing rule
lowering_target: ReduceSum row-column masks, small Conv kernels, constant masks plus Where
reject_lowering: full-grid Tile, long Where chain, per-cell ScatterND
best_practice: 線分単位の閉形式maskを作り、unrollしない。

lowering_target: static row-column prefix masks, small Conv kernels, bounded room mask
reject_lowering: many-step flood fill, dilation unroll, dynamic full-grid colormap
best_practice: flood fillの正しさを利用しても、実装は閉形式の部屋maskへ落とす。

lowering_target: Transpose, Gather, initializer prune, small color Conv
reject_lowering: compact artifactより大きい再実装
best_practice: 既存artifactが小さい場合はrule ONNXよりsurgeryの方を優先する。
単独改善より他familyの前処理として使う。
